title: $20,000 Inside a Fake Constitution: The DA's Lockbox

lines.say: About twenty thousand dollars in cash, in a lockbox made to look like the Constitution. The F.B.I. found it in a district attorney's office.
lines.show: About $20,000 in cash, in a lockbox made to look like "The Constitution." The FBI found it in a district attorney's office.

lines.say: That day, an agent asked him about safes or lockboxes. According to the indictment, he said: none exist.
lines.show: That day, an agent asked him about safes or lockboxes. According to the indictment, he said: "none exist."

scene.src: Indictment, U.S. v. Owens, Lumumba & Banks (S.D. Miss. 3:24-cr-103)

lines.say: About nine thousand nine hundred of that cash matched, by serial number, money undercover F.B.I. developers gave him on a yacht.
lines.show: About $9,900 of that cash matched, by serial number, money undercover FBI developers gave him on a yacht.

scene.src: Indictment, U.S. v. Owens, Lumumba & Banks (S.D. Miss. 3:24-cr-103)

lines.say: Jody Owens pleaded guilty. Forty-one months.

scene.sub: Ex-DA Jody Owens · plus a $100,000 fine

lines.say: Was that enough for a prosecutor?
